description: Builds (unless build:false) and runs the full Gamealia autotest locally in headless Chromium, desktop 1280x720 and mobile 390x844, the same checks as the server: SDK lifecycle, blank screen, input response, ads (mock), console errors, static security analysis. Run it before gamealia_upload_version, which repeats it on the server. No login; writes screenshots and report.json to a temp folder; takes a while (progress notifications). Returns pass/warn/fail, the failed checks with fixes, the screenshot paths and key screenshots as images.

backendHosts.description: Your own servers the game may call, as in the listing, e.g. ["mp.example.com"]; other external hosts are flagged

build.description: Run the build command first when the project has one (default true)

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

images.description: How many screenshots to return as images, 0-6 (default 3); all paths are listed anyway

multiplayer.description: The listing's multiplayer, as in gamealia_create_game (null = single player): the warn-only `multiplayer` check compares it with the room APIs your code uses

name: gamealia_run_autotest
title: Run the autotest locally
